details: Additive transactional migration19 adds DM clientMessageId, thread/fcm tables, missing enum/indexes/FKs. Backfills legacy threads, latest message (timestamp+ID tie break), unread counts. Existing four indexes are declared in schema rather than dropped. Fresh and populated18->19 upgrades on Node25/22 preserve history and wallets, read/send/read-state/retry and local FCM CRUD pass; repeated deploy is no-op and drift0. Initial schema edit put indexes on the wrong model; corrected before final fresh/upgrade checks. Exploratory drift DB is used; final and node22 DBs are independent fresh proofs. No production migration.
